intro.text: The surname of the first family from the Homeland to settle the Forests of Hell, people who live by the forest instead of shutting it out as the fortfolk do.

description.text: Many settlers followed, but the Forescouts came first, and they are fiercely proud of it. They boast that they can face the forest head-on where others turn their eyes away.
Hardened by many dangers, they can be very stern, a way of teaching their children to survive in the forest.
